decision_notes: Official Assembly Business describes primary Acts, scrutiny and subsidiary legislation; Constitution section 71 gives general lawmaking and the Constitution establishes ministerial government/public-finance controls. British Overseas Territory, not an ordinary UK administrative subdivision. Primary evidence: https://parliament.ms/assembly-business/ ; https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2474/pdfs/uksi_20102474_en.pdf

The official site explicitly designates its channel. Meeting 18 of the 18th Parliament, Part 3, plays beyond the opening graphic and shows chamber debate. Part 2 opens in an empty room at the sampled time. Footer terms/privacy links point to a fintech website-template vendor; they are not treated as institutional media permissions.

Source conditions: The reviewed official pages designate public viewing and retain copyright notices; no independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Keep the official link rather than extracting, embedding or redistributing provider media.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
